key_entities: CI is a venue, not a dependency
propositions: The project portability criterion's matrix cell treats CI as a single undifferentiated venue, rendering projects with no CI provider or alternate CI systems undetectable as portability violations

A plan scheduled to run only via GitHub Actions with no operation-linked or in-process fallback silently fails when consumed without CI or on a different CI platform, but the rubric cannot name this shape and draws no finding

The rubric detection text, its unit test pinning, the hand-authored doc mirror, and agent guidance all require concurrent update to establish an authoritative wording that a specific-CI-only trigger is not portable

Live A/B testing on a GitHub-Actions-only compaction plan confirms the pre-change rubric emits zero project.portability findings while the post-change rubric correctly detects and names the no-CI-provider breakage
